author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Embedded tokio-tungstenite server bound to 127.0.0.1:0 with state machine: accept → send frames 1..K → close → accept reconnect → parse ?cursor=K → send frames K+1..N. FirehoseWorker drives against the fixture. Assertion pins post-reconnect events carry seq > disconnect-point seq (proves cursor-driven resume, not just frame-count). Close path uses WebSocket close frame with reconnect-eligible code, not connection drop. tokio-tungstenite as dev-dep (reuse workspace pin if available). Forbidden patterns: no unwrap/expect outside cfg(test) (whole file IS test code).
